summary: Catch Rate & Minlucks now shows attraction rates, accurately calculated based on your setup, location, and location stage. Rearrange and hide the blocks under your trap with the new Custom Trap Selector, item and mouse popups now show more data, and more things are now able to be pinned to the top menu! Happy hunting!

details.title: New
items: Catch Rate & Minlucks: See which mice you're likely to attract, from real hunt data for your exact stage, cheese, and charm
Catch Rate & Minlucks: An overall catch rate for whatever shows up next, which updates as your stage changes
Custom Trap Selector: Rearrange and hide the blocks under your trap
Better Item Details and Better Mice: See which mice drop an item, and what a mouse drops
Spring Egg Hunt: A new Egg Hunt Helper to track down every egg
Custom Menu: Add Favorite Setups, Journal Logs, Keyboard Shortcuts, and your uncaught mice count to the top menu
Better Maps: Send SUPER|brie+ to the Maptain right from the map
Better Shops: See the total cost for the quantity you enter
Better Mice: A redesigned mouse view
Max Title: Show custom text, a random title, or the progress bar in place of your Fabled title
Dark Mode Color Schemes: Try new dark and light color schemes (Experimental)

details.title: Fixed and Updated
items: Collapsed sections stay collapsed across the game
Beta options are now in each module's settings
Better Maps: Completed locations are grouped together, and attraction rates always show
Better Travel: Cursed and twisted location names in the travel menu
Custom Menu: Opening pinned convertibles now shows the new journal entries
Dark Mode: Refreshed colors, with blue links in place of purple
Lots of smaller fixes and style tweaks
